SCRIPT M-Cn Good morning, captain. We'll be docking at the port in Kolkata this evening, right? W-Am Actually, we had to change course overnight to avoid a storm, so we're running behind schedule. But we should arrive early tomorrow. M-Cn Well, that’s not too bad. W-Am Oh, Hector has the day off today, so I'll need you to do the morning rounds— starting with checking the machinery in the engine room. M-Cn Of course—I'll head there now.

SCRIPT M-Cn Hi. I’m here to schedule some personal training sessions. W-Br OK. What are your fitness goals? M-Cn I’d like to lift weights and build strength. W-Br I can work with you on that. Are you currently a member here? M-Cn No, I'll also need to sign up for a membership. I saw online that you're running a special for new members—fifty percent off the first month’s membership. Can I sign up for that? W-Br Absolutely. But before I get you signed up, let me show you around our facility.

SCRIPT W-Am As you can see, this Renaissance landscape painting we acquired is in bad condition. We can’t display it yet. M-Cn Hmm, yes. This painting will need significant restoration work. W-Am I’ll begin by investigating the artist's color palette and style to see how we should repair the damaged areas. M-Cn You know, this would be a stunning piece to unveil at our anniversary dinner in June. And, since it’s a big project to finish by then, we should get started right away.

SCRIPT W-Br Hi, Ozan. Do you have time to review some slides I’m presenting at a meeting on Thursday? M-Au Oh. Is that the meeting with Smith Incorporated? W-Br Yes. I'm presenting them with our updated marketing plan for their chain of bookstores. M-Au You know, Smith Incorporated prefers informal meetings. I think just a handout highlighting how our marketing plan will positively impact their book sales would be enough. W-Br Really? Thilo, you've worked with this client before. What do you think? M-Gn Ozan is right. I think they’d prefer a meeting that was more of a conversation than a presentation.

SCRIPT W-Am I heard that the results of your experiment were better than you expected. Congratulations! M-Au Thanks! I thought we’d have to run that reaction ten times before we got a positive result. But we got it on the third try. W-Am You'll have to write up your results and submit them to the research director. That’s Esra, right? M-Au Oh, Esra’s leaving the company next week. W-Am Oh, I didn’t know that. I wonder if you'll be promoted to fill her position. M-Au I don’t think so. I’ve never managed an entire research group. I hope to get some experience doing that next quarter.

SCRIPT W-Am Now we'll move on to a special segment of our news program where we highlight new local businesses for our viewers. Today I’m talking with Dhruv Bajaj—a personal trainer and gym owner. Thanks for coming into the studio today, Dhruv! M-Cn Thanks for having me! I’m excited to tell you about the gym I just opened last month. It has state-of-the-art equipment, and my trainers can work with clients at any stage in their fitness journey. W-Am Sounds great. How did you get started in this line of work? M-Cn Well, I was an athlete in school, and when I stopped competing, I wanted to continue doing something fitness-related. So I started working as a trainer.

SCRIPT M-Au As director, I’m delighted to welcome you to the Redmond Aquatic Institute. We're happy you'll be producing content for our Web site. W-Br I'm looking forward to writing about Redmond’s initiatives in marine biology. M-Au Yes, the more articles the public can read about threats to aquatic ecosystems, the better. Public awareness will help us get funding to meet our aim of preserving these ecosystems. This is Roberto. He’s working on our mangrove research project, which is the first one you'll cover. M-Cn It’s an interesting project. And what’s exciting is that we've started using drones to photograph the area with the mangroves. So we have some great images you could use.

SCRIPT W-Am Matthew, you’re not planning to cancel Wednesday’s budget meeting, are you? M-Au I haven’t sent out the cancellation yet, but our research partners in China are off this week for a national holiday, so there’s no point in meeting. Why? W-Am Well, I’ve been looking at the draft budget, and We didn’t allocate funds for a project leader. M-Au Uh-oh. I wonder how that happened. You're right. We need to discuss how to fix that. W-Am You know, we allocated money for a trip to Singapore to present our preliminary findings. We don't really need to do that.

SCRIPT M-Cn Hello, you've reached tech support. W-Br I’m calling from Rubin Restaurant Equipment. I recently purchased your software to keep track of my warehouse inventory, and I have a question about setting alerts. M-Cn Sure. How can I help? W-Br Well, we've been getting an alert whenever the inventory for our deep fryers drops below ten. But we usually don’t stock many of those because restaurants don’t often need to replace them. So, can I lower the alert level for just those items? M-Cn Yes. In the system, if you click on that product, you'll see a link that says, “Set Custom Alert.” And you can set it to any number from there. W-Br I see it. Thanks for your help.

SCRIPT M-Au I just spoke to the garden director. He wants us to install an irrigation system in the rose garden as well as the magnolia grove. He wants to be sure the flowers get plenty of water during the hot summer months. W-Br OK, let’s walk over there now and take some measurements. Then we can figure out what materials we'll need. M-Au Sure. We have some extra parts left over from when we worked on the cherry trees. I'll check what we have left after we finish measuring the rose garden.

SCRIPT M-Au Good morning, Ms. Aljohani. Sorry I'm a little late. Traffic was terrible. W-Am That's OK, but our rental office will be very busy this morning. There’s a big education convention in town starting today, and a lot of attendees from out of town have reserved cars to get to the conference center. M-Au Right. What do you want me to do first? W-Am I'd like you to start by checking the batteries in our electric cars. We want to be sure they’re all fully charged.

SCRIPT M-Au I’ve been on vacation, so I missed our department’s meeting. Can you give me an update? W-Br Well, all our public programs and community events are on schedule. M-Au Great! How about the Jannis Park project? We're still planning on planting trees best suited for residential areas, right? W-Br That’s right. I’m working on the public education part now. There'll be a children’s poster competition next month, which the city mayor will judge. M-Au Interesting. Is there a prize? W-Br The winner will get a ribbon. But all participants will get a seedling to plant at home. We'll be giving away the tallest of these four varieties, since it was the most popular in a survey of our residents.

SCRIPT M-Cn Hi, I'd like a large black coffee and an egg-and-cheese croissant, please. W-Am Sure. That'll be eight dollars. Are you a Shelby’s preferred customer? M-Cn Uh, no I'm not. Would you like to do that now? M-Cn No, I’ll call you later today when I know what everyone wants. Thanks for the information.

SCRIPT W-Br Hi, Amina. This is Sabine calling from Blue Drop Creations. I just put the earrings and necklaces that you ordered from me in the mail. This is a new product that I’m starting to offer, so please call me back after you receive it. I'd really like to hear your thoughts on it.

SCRIPT M-Au Good morning, this is Brandon from Dakota Framing Company, returning your call. We received your voicemail about wanting to frame a wedding picture. There is no need to print the photo yourself. We prefer that you e-mail us a digital copy. So, to answer your question, you can complete the whole order online. Just visit our Web site, where you'll fill in your choices for photo size and the frame and upload your photo. And for a small extra cost, we'll guarantee to replace your frame in case of damage. Please be sure to check that box when you order.

SCRIPT M-Cn Welcome all to this week’s training in our series of patient care programs. Our physical therapy center is known for the excellent care we provide to our patients, and that’s because of you, our staff. The training today will be about ways to engage the patients who reside in our facility through playing games. I've prepared different types of activities for us to try out, including some games that involve mental stimulation as well as physical exercises. But, I have to let you know that today I must leave at noon. Next week we'll try out more of the games.

SCRIPT M-Au Are you a certified commercial truck driver? Hoffman Oversized Haulers is currently looking for experienced truck drivers to join our team. As our name suggests, we transport oversized cargo throughout the region. With Hoffman, drivers enjoy flexible scheduling. In fact, we're the only company in the region that allows employees to determine their own work hours. If you don’t have experience working with oversized loads, training is available. Please check out our Web site to learn more about our open positions. We can’t wait to work with you.

SCRIPT Hi, Jinyu. I have some exciting news! The Farmer's Table television program wants to feature our restaurant in an upcoming episode. They’ll be coming on Wednesday to film everyone at work in the kitchen during our dinner service. Since you're the executive chef, I'll need you to come in earlier than usual to get everything prepped and set up. And just as a reminder, I'm still planning to be out of town next week for the Springdale Pastry and Dessert Festival. Thanks!

SCRIPT M-Cn Good evening and thank you for watching Channel Four News. I’m here in Rockville, a suburb in the metropolitan area. Rockville was recently chosen as the site of a multimillion-dollar electric vehicle battery factory. This project promises to bring thousands of jobs, both directly and indirectly, to the surrounding community. At a recent well-attended public comment meeting, residents had a chance to voice any opposition to the project. No one made any comments. To learn more about this exciting development, artist-rendered images of the project are on display at the city hall building.

SCRIPT W-Br Tired of losing things on your desk because it’s too cluttered? If so, the Optimum Space Organizer is the perfect product for you. Designed with office employees like you in mind, this product can make even the messiest of desks look neat again. Best of all, the organizer adjusts to any sized space you may have on your desk. It can be as narrow or as wide as you need it to be—within seconds! If you call in the next ten minutes, you'll receive a 30 percent discount!

SCRIPT W-Am Thanks for listening to this episode of Fabulous Foods. Every week, we discuss a different vegetable and ways to cook with it to maximize flavor. Now, before we get started, I’m excited to announce that I've been collaborating with Cartwell Kitchen Supplies to develop a new line of cookware. It'll be released in November, but it’s available for preorder right now. Keep in mind, this product line will not be available for long. OK, let’s move on to our program. With us today is renowned chef Rebecca Murray to talk about this week’s vegetable: eggplant! Rebecca recently launched a vegetarian restaurant in New York that is getting rave reviews so far.

SCRIPT W-Br Attention passengers. Renovation work to upgrade and modernize our train station is underway. We apologize for the inconvenience the construction noise may cause. Please note that regional train schedules are not affected. Train 133 with service to Washington, D.C., will be arriving shortly. All passengers to Washington, please proceed to Track 26B. If you need assistance handling your baggage, please speak to a ticket agent immediately. Train 133’s next stop will be Wilmington, followed by Baltimore and then Washington, D.C.

SCRIPT W-Am Hello, everyone. I’m Carmen Salazar, the airport operations director, and I wanted to thank you for attending this press conference. As of this week, construction on the new regional airport is proceeding on schedule for two of the three terminals. Minor design adjustments to terminal A have put the project slightly behind schedule, and we anticipate about two months will be added to the construction time frame as a result. l'd also like to mention that we now have a 3-D printed model of this project! Please feel free to visit our Web site so you can view it.

Rainy To Move Headquarters

DADE (July 11)—Rainy LLC announced yesterday that it is moving its headquarters to Dade.

     A data storage and analytics firm currently based in Salt Creek, Rainy has clients that include some of the country's largest credit card companies, online retailers, and software providers. Rainy helps these businesses manage and understand their customer data.

     Rainy is not planning to close its current offices in Salt Creek. However, the Dade location will become its new base of operations, as several members of its executive team will work there. The company's chief executive officer and chief financial officer will relocate to Dade along with approximately 50 percent of the company's workforce.

     The office of Rainy's chief technology officer will remain in Salt Creek, as will the account management team. The company's new Dade offices are located at 12 Glacier Parkway.

Shipping Disruptions

SINGAPORE (6 June)—Recently, the demand for international freight space has been outpacing the availability of shipping containers. This container shortage has led to higher costs for goods being shipped out of Asian ports. A drop in the production of rolls of steel, the raw material that containers are made from, has further complicated the situation. — [1] —.

Some exporters have considered the more expensive option of air freight, but companies are still faced with a difficult choice. — [2] —. They must either ask their customers to accept shipment delays, or substantially raise customer prices to cover the costs of expedited shipping. Either way, suppliers risk triggering customer dissatisfaction.

"We are working with business partners, investors, and government officials to discuss solutions to this problem," said Henry Lam, a spokesperson for the household goods producer QET Group. — [3] —. "It's going to take total cooperation of all stakeholders to find a solution."

Not all companies are suffering, though. For example, Fezker, the producer of athletic apparel and footwear, has implemented strategies to better overcome this situation. Fezker has successfully refocused its efforts away from exports to western countries and toward expanding its domestic and regional markets. — [4] —.

"We moved quickly, so the shipping container shortage has not caused a significant impact on our profits," said Fezker CEO Nuwa Lee.

Subject:	Taste-test results
Attachment:	📎 Fatior Labs survey results

Hi, Team.

I just received the 24–26 January survey results from Fatior Labs for our new ice-cream taste test. As you can see from the attached document, the results are very disappointing. We sent the four flavours that we considered to be the best, but none of them received high enough ratings to advance to the next stage of development. Most of the reviews were consistent among the 92 taste-test participants in our target market of consumers ages 25 through 40. It's not a big problem if a product gets low scores in colour in the testing phase, since we can easily adjust that in the laboratory. But we should never be sending out samples that are getting scores lower than 3 in the taste category.

I would like to meet at 9 A.M. on Monday (6 February) to figure out how to proceed. There is one flavour we may be able to work with if we make a few adjustments, as suggested by most of our taste testers. We will also need to get some new flavours to Fatior Labs no later than 1 March if we are going to get a new ice cream on the Preston Grocers freezer shelves by the beginning of June.

Madalyn Kerluke

Bring your team together to promote cooperation while having fun! Our activities increase job satisfaction and engagement. We do all the planning so you can relax. Simply choose the event that is right for your team.

Game Day—This is a high-energy game day with fun team activities. This event builds team strength, communication, and problem-solving skills. Group size: 20–500 people. Time: 2 hours.

Team Painting—Each team member creates a painting outdoors based on a predetermined theme. The paintings are linked together at the end. Group size: 6–30 people. Time: 1–2 hours.

Robot Building—Your group will be broken into teams. Each team builds a robot to be used in challenges against the others. Group size: 10–30 people. Time: 2–3 hours.

All Chocolate—Your group will have the chance to use engineering skills to build a tower of chocolate. Then you learn how to make chocolate from a local chocolatier. Group size: 8–150 people. Time: 2 hours.

questions.stem: Before operating your handheld device, please ------ the enclosed cable to charge it.

questions.stem: Safile’s new external hard drive can ------ store up to one terabyte of data.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống nằm sau động từ khiếm khuyết "can" và trước động từ chính "store", nên cần một trạng từ để bổ nghĩa cho động từ "store".

questions.stem: Mr. Peterson will travel ------ the Tokyo office for the annual meeting.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc "travel to + địa điểm" dùng để chỉ hướng di chuyển đến một nơi nào đó. Trong trường hợp này là di chuyển đến văn phòng Tokyo.

questions.stem: Yong-Soo Cosmetics will not charge for items on back order until ------ have left our warehouse.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống làm chủ ngữ cho mệnh đề "have left our warehouse". Vì "items" (các món hàng) là danh từ số nhiều đã được nhắc đến, ta dùng đại từ "they" để thay thế.

questions.stem: Our premium day tour takes visitors to historic sites ------ the Aprico River.
questions.explanation: Giới từ "along" (dọc theo) phù hợp nhất để mô tả vị trí của các địa danh lịch sử nằm trải dài theo dòng sông Aprico.

questions.stem: Eighty percent of drivers surveyed said they would consider buying a vehicle that runs on ------
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ "on" cần một danh từ để chỉ nguồn năng lượng. "Electricity" là danh từ phù hợp nhất để chỉ loại xe chạy bằng điện.

questions.stem: Xinzhe Zu has ------ Petrin Engineering as the vice president of operations.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào ngữ cảnh "với tư cách là phó chủ tịch điều hành", động từ "joined" (gia nhập) là phù hợp nhất để chỉ việc bắt đầu làm việc tại một công ty.

questions.stem: Next month, Barder House Books will be holding ------ third author’s hour in Cleveland.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống cần một tính từ sở hữu bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "third author’s hour". Vì chủ ngữ là tên tổ chức số ít, ta dùng "its".

questions.stem: Chester’s Tiles ------ expanded to a second location in Turnington.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống cần một trạng từ để bổ nghĩa cho động từ "expanded". "Recently" (gần đây) chỉ một hành động vừa xảy ra trong quá khứ/hiện tại hoàn thành.

questions.stem: Tabrino’s has ------ increased the number of almonds in the Nut Medley snack pack.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống cần một trạng từ để bổ nghĩa cho động từ "increased". "Significantly" thường được dùng để mô tả sự thay đổi lớn về số lượng.

questions.stem: ------ she travels, Jacintha Flores collects samples of local fabrics and patterns.
questions.explanation: "Wherever" là liên từ chỉ nơi chốn (bất cứ nơi nào), phù hợp để kết nối thói quen của Jacintha với các chuyến đi của cô.

questions.stem: Most picture ------ at Glowing Photo Lab go on sale at 3:00 p.m. today.
questions.explanation: Cụm danh từ "picture frames" (khung ảnh) là một danh từ ghép. "Frames" ở dạng số nhiều đóng vai trò là danh từ chính làm chủ ngữ.

questions.stem: All students in the business management class hold ------ college degrees.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ "advanced degrees" là một thuật ngữ cố định để chỉ các bằng cấp cao (như Thạc sĩ, Tiến sĩ).

questions.stem: We hired Noah Wan of Shengyao Accounting Ltd. ------ our company’s financial assets.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc "hire someone to do something". Để chỉ mục đích của hành động "thuê", ta dùng dạng nguyên mẫu "to evaluate".

questions.stem: Ms. Charisse is taking on a new account ------ she finishes the Morrison project.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào logic thời gian, hành động nhận tài khoản mới xảy ra "sau khi" hoàn thành dự án cũ.

questions.stem: Cormet Motors’ profits are ------ this year than last year.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc so sánh hơn với tính từ ngắn: "higher... than". Dấu hiệu "than" cho biết cần dùng dạng so sánh hơn để đối chiếu lợi nhuận năm nay và năm ngoái.

questions.stem: In its ------ advertising campaign, Jaymor Tools demonstrates how reliable its products are.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống cần một tính từ để bổ nghĩa cho cụm danh từ "advertising campaign". "Current" (hiện tại) là tính từ phù hợp nhất về nghĩa trong ngữ cảnh này.

questions.stem: Remember to submit receipts for reimbursement ------ returning from a business trip.
questions.explanation: "When" đóng vai trò là liên từ chỉ thời gian, đứng trước một cụm V-ing (rút gọn chủ ngữ) để chỉ thời điểm cần thực hiện hành động nộp biên lai.

questions.stem: Patrons will be able to access Westside Library’s ------ acquired collection of books on Tuesday.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống cần một trạng từ để bổ nghĩa cho tính từ (quá khứ phân từ) "acquired". "Newly acquired" là cụm từ phổ biến nghĩa là "mới thu mua/có được".

questions.stem: Please ------ any questions about time sheets to Tabitha Jones in the payroll department.
questions.explanation: Sau "Please" cần một động từ nguyên mẫu để tạo thành câu mệnh lệnh. "Direct" (gửi/hướng tới) là động từ phù hợp để yêu cầu gửi câu hỏi đến đúng người.

questions.stem: Before signing a delivery ------ , be sure to double-check that all the items ordered are in the shipment.
questions.explanation: Cụm danh từ "delivery receipt" (biên lai giao hàng) là một thuật ngữ cố định trong ngữ cảnh kiểm tra hàng hóa khi nhận hàng.

questions.stem: Funds have been added to the budget for expenses ------ with the new building.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ: "expenses (which are) associated with...". Cụm "associated with" có nghĩa là "liên quan đến/gắn liền với".

questions.stem: Ms. Bernard ------ that a deadline was approaching, so she requested some assistance.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào ngữ cảnh "thấy hạn chót đang đến gần", động từ "noticed" (nhận thấy) là hợp lý nhất để dẫn đến hành động yêu cầu hỗ trợ.

questions.stem: Mr. Moscowitz is ------ that Dr. Tanaka will agree to present the keynote speech at this year’s conference.
questions.explanation: Sau động từ "is" cần một tính từ để mô tả trạng thái của chủ ngữ. "Hopeful" (hy vọng/đầy hy vọng) phù hợp để chỉ cảm xúc của ông Moscowitz.

questions.stem: Two Australian companies are developing new smartphones, but it is unclear ------ phone will become available first.
questions.explanation: "Which" được dùng như một từ để hỏi/từ nối để lựa chọn giữa các đối tượng đã được xác định (trong trường hợp này là hai công ty điện thoại).

questions.stem: Corners Gym offers its members a free lesson in how to use ------ properly.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống cần một danh từ làm tân ngữ sau động từ "use". "Weights" (quả tạ/tạ) phù hợp với ngữ cảnh phòng tập Gym.

questions.stem: ------ the rules, overnight parking is not permitted at the clubhouse facility.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ "According to" (theo như) là giới từ dùng để dẫn chiếu đến một quy định hoặc nguồn thông tin.

questions.stem: Once everyone ------ , we can begin the conference call.
questions.explanation: Đây là câu điều kiện/chỉ thời gian. "Once" (một khi) đóng vai trò liên từ, mệnh đề sau nó dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành để nhấn mạnh hành động đã hoàn tất.

questions.stem: Each summer a motivational video that highlights the past year’s ------ is shown to all company employees.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống cần một danh từ để chỉ kết quả tích cực của năm qua. "Accomplishments" (thành tựu) là từ phù hợp nhất để chiếu trong video truyền cảm hứng.

questions.stem: Employees who wish to attend the retirement dinner ------ Ms. Howell's 30 years of service should contact Mr. Lee.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống cần một cụm động từ chỉ mục đích (to-V) để bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "dinner". "To honor" (để vinh danh) giải thích mục đích của bữa tiệc.
Cần một tính từ đứng trước để bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "order". "Special order" (đơn hàng đặc biệt) là một cụm từ cố định trong kinh doanh để chỉ những đơn hàng không có sẵn hoặc theo yêu cầu riêng.
Câu trước có liệt kê "dining table" và "chairs". Danh từ "furniture" (đồ nội thất) là từ bao quát phù hợp nhất để thay thế cho các món đồ vừa nêu trên.
Cấu trúc "ask to speak to someone" (yêu cầu được nói chuyện với ai đó). Trong ngữ cảnh này, "to speak" là dạng nguyên mẫu có "to" đóng vai trò bổ ngữ mục đích sau động từ "ask".

options.text: He can schedule a convenient time.
He can meet you at 11:00 a.m.

questions.explanation: Câu trước nhắc đến việc gọi cho quản lý giao hàng. Câu A là sự tiếp nối logic nhất vì giải thích lý do khách hàng cần gặp người quản lý này (để sắp xếp thời gian giao hàng thuận tiện).
Sau tính từ sở hữu "your" và trước liên từ "and" (đi cùng danh từ "comfort") cần một danh từ. "Safety" (sự an toàn) tạo thành cặp danh từ song hành phù hợp với ngữ cảnh dịch vụ máy lạnh.
Trạng từ liên kết "Furthermore" (Ngoài ra/Hơn nữa) được dùng để thêm một dịch vụ bổ sung (thay thế hệ thống cũ) sau khi đã liệt kê các dịch vụ bảo trì định kỳ ở câu trước.

options.text: Take advantage of dozens of useful online tools.
Moreover, the air conditioner you chose is very popular.
Plus, they are friendly, clean, and knowledgeable.
Thank you for visiting our contractor showroom.

questions.explanation: Câu trước ca ngợi trình độ chuyên môn của công nhân. Câu C tiếp tục bổ sung các phẩm chất tốt đẹp khác của họ (thân thiện, sạch sẽ, am hiểu), tạo nên một sự giới thiệu nhất quán về đội ngũ.
Cần một phân từ (P2) để đóng vai trò mệnh đề quan hệ rút gọn mang nghĩa bị động. "Backed by" (được bảo đảm/được hậu thuẫn bởi) là cụm từ chuẩn để nói về một lời hứa đi kèm với sự bảo hành.
Động từ "vary" (thay đổi/khác nhau) phù hợp để nói về việc giá của các sản phẩm cụ thể sẽ không giống nhau sau khi điều chỉnh.
Chỗ trống cần một phân từ (P2) để đóng vai trò mệnh đề quan hệ rút gọn mang nghĩa bị động: "orders (which are) received" (những đơn hàng được nhận).

options.text: The updated price list will be available on March 20.
Your orders will be shipped after April 17.
We are increasing prices because of rising costs.

questions.explanation: Câu văn tiếp theo đề cập đến việc "Khách hàng có thể tìm thấy cái này trên trang web". Vì vậy, đáp án A về việc cung cấp bảng giá mới là sự kết nối logic nhất.
Cần một tính từ đứng trước danh từ "service" để bổ nghĩa. "Exceptional service" (dịch vụ xuất sắc/ngoại lệ) là một cụm từ cố định thường dùng trong thư gửi khách hàng.

options.text: If you need more time, please let me know.

questions.explanation: Câu trước khen ngợi về thiết kế và chất lượng. Đáp án D bổ sung thêm một ưu điểm nữa là "giá cả hợp lý", giải thích trọn vẹn lý do tại sao hàng lại bán chạy.
Kenneth muốn "tăng số lượng đơn đặt hàng". Trong các lựa chọn, "double" (gấp đôi) là hành động cụ thể và phù hợp nhất với ý định tăng số lượng hàng.
Cụm từ "serve us both" (phục vụ/có lợi cho cả hai chúng ta) là cách diễn đạt phổ biến khi nói về một thỏa thuận hợp tác đôi bên cùng có lợi (win-win).
